Files and subfolders

Each entry links to the file or to the child folder's guide. Source summaries are navigation aids; they do not replace the implementation or its tests.

File or folder Responsibility
v54/ Archived v54 served-manual pages covering installation, UI, capabilities, storage and integrations. Their page identities and historical content are preserved for reference; current guides live in the parent manual content tree.
01_overview_for_humans.md Runtime Overview For Humans: This document explains the runtime without assuming you already think like a planner, compiler, or distributed systems engineer.
02_request_lifecycle.md Request Lifecycle: This document explains the current request lifecycle stage by stage.
03_components_and_boundaries.md Components And Boundaries: This document explains the major subsystems, what each one owns, and where the hard boundaries are.
04_llm_stages_and_contracts.md LLM Stages And Contracts: This document explains where the LLM is involved, what it may decide, and what the runtime checks before trusting the result.
05_capabilities_safety_and_gateway.md Capabilities, Safety, And Gateway: This document explains the current executable surface, how safety policy gates it, and how shell commands reach the real environment.
07_user_manual.md Agent UI User Manual: This manual explains how to use the local SMTO Agent UI and where its state is stored.
architecture.md Agent Runtime Documentation: This page is the landing page for the current runtime documentation suite.

<!-- directory-inventory:end -->
